## Cat Key 1.10.0: CatGPT, meme cats, and timer endings

**⬇ [Download for Windows](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-Setup-x64.exe)** or the [portable exe](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-portable-x64.exe) · **[Download for Mac](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-mac.dmg)** (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11+).

### CatGPT: show Claude or ChatGPT what's on your screen, fast
- **A new tab and your own keys** (one click sets Ctrl+Shift+Space, or ⌘⇧Space on a Mac). The keys open a **wheel that spins out around the pointer**: rest on a choice to pick it, or click.
- **Screenshot** the screen you're on, small and sharp.
- **Draw on the screen**: it freezes into a canvas with a pen, highlighter, arrows, boxes and text. Add it to the basket, then make another canvas (the screen again, or a blank page) and keep going.
- **Record** a very light video: a low frame rate and bitrate keep text readable and files tiny. Stop it from the little pill at the top, or with your keys.
- **Notes and files** go in too: type a note in the wheel, pick files, or drop them on the CatGPT tab.
- **The basket** keeps it all, in Cat Key's own folder, with **Clear everything** when you're done.
- **Send** to the Claude or ChatGPT app on your computer: **a new chat, the chat that's open, or a recent one**. Everything lands in the message box and waits, so you can change the model or effort first. Or choose **Send it right away**. Recordings go as a few stills, because AI chats read pictures.
- Mac: macOS asks once for Screen & System Audio Recording.

### Meme cats
- **29 new cats** drawn from famous cat memes, each as our own cartoon cat with the look or prop that made it famous: the crying thumbs-up cat, the dinner-table cat, the "we're so back" pilot, the cat in a suit, the money cat, the ballerina, the fur-hat cat, the knight, the screaming cat, the confused maths cat, "get in", the burrito kitten, the smug one, the polite cat and more.
- **Each one recolours the whole app**: the window, the Dock, the switcher, coach tips and the timer's ending.
- Their signature pieces join the wardrobe for every cat, unlocked by rank.

### Focus timer endings
- **The cat walk, the spinning cat** (it spins in the middle of your screen singing its own little song), or **shuffle** for a different one each time.
- **Motion** and **sound** each have a switch. Choose in the Dock's Focus page or Settings → Cat Dock.

### Also
- The shipped app's code is minified in release builds (the source stays readable in the repo).

**Mac, first open:** Cat Key isn't notarized by Apple yet. Open it once, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. If that goes round in circles, paste this into Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Cat Key.app" && open "/Applications/Cat Key.app"`.
